verdict.rationale: Granola documents a REST API ([granola-docs-33]) that is pitched for building custom agents ([granola-docs-34]). Workspace admins can create workspace API keys that belong to the workspace rather than an individual user ([granola-docs-28]). That implies a coarse user-vs-workspace ownership split, but there is no evidence of permission scopes, read-only keys, or per-resource limits, and workspace keys are documented as non-expiring, which works against least privilege. Missing for 10: granular permission scopes, read-only or limited-access keys, per-folder or per-resource restriction, expiry/rotation controls, any independent corroboration.
